feedback: This feedback is written before the robot has raced, so it states no outcome for this candidate. The baseline (iteration 0) had all 60 trials end off track, with max_error about 0.06 m on every track, 1 to 2 line-loss events, steering oscillation 0.07 to 0.16 and progress 0.10 to 0.19. That pattern points at the array losing the tape under drift, since the 10 mm spacing with 12 mm footprints covers only about ±0.02 m. Your proposed ±0.03 m spread is the right direction. To keep the signal scale comparable, the integrator raised kp and lowered kd, so please keep the spacing near 15 mm and the weights symmetric. Next race, if line_loss_events is still above zero on the s-bend or slalom with max_error near 0.06 m, widen the outer sensors further (for example, x = ±0.036 m) so the tape stays under a sensor out to about 0.04 m of drift. If steering_oscillation stays above about 0.1 while rms_error is low, move the row to y = 0.0 (at the axle) to cut lookahead lag further. If the robot leaves the track with line loss at 0 and max_error still near 0.06 m, the limit is more likely controller speed or gain than geometry, so keep the sensor layout and do not change the body.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events > 0 on the s-bend or slalom with max_error near 0.06 m: widen the outer sensors to x = ±0.036 m, keeping 15 mm spacing for the middle three. Evidence basis: iteration 0 showed line loss of 1 to 2 events per run and max_error of 0.06 m on every track, consistent with the tape leaving the ±0.02 m array.

If steering_oscillation stays above about 0.1 while rms_error is below 0.03: move the sensor row to y = 0.0 (at the axle) instead of y = 0.02. Evidence basis: iteration 0 oscillation of 0.07 to 0.16 on the s-bend and slalom, where the 4 cm lookahead was the suspected cause.

If line_loss_events is 0 and max_error is still at the 0.06 m limit: keep the sensor array unchanged and test sensor_size 0.016 to cover more of the tape under each sensor. Evidence basis: the 12 mm footprint in iteration 0 covered only part of the 25 mm tape at the edges, and all trials ended off track at the same max_error, which points to the signal reach at the edge.
